remarks: VRP Seller will entertain offers from $249900 to $ 279900. Welcome home to this charming all-brick 3-bedroom ranch offering comfort, convenience, and plenty of updates! Ideally located just minutes from Thruway access, shopping, and everyday amenities, this 1,200 sq ft home offers easy one-floor living with a spacious layout and great features throughout. Step inside to a comfortable living room and dining area featuring beautiful hardwood floors. The eat-in kitchen provides plenty of cabinet and counter space. The three bedrooms are nicely sized, and the full bathroom offers convenience for the entire household. The partially finished basement adds valuable extra living space and provides excellent storage options, including room in the basement and attached one-car garage. Recent updates include a new A/C unit, new garage door, some updated plumbing, and a sump pump approximately five years old. The basement and garage feature durable glass block windows. Outside, enjoy a fully fenced backyard, a good-sized storage shed, and a great space for relaxing, entertaining, or gardening. This well-maintained and updated ranch home offers a fantastic opportunity and is ready for its next owner
